# File secrets use unlinked read-only descriptors; dotenv values use their
# declared names. Neither selector is revealed into the worktree.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'
exec sesam init --user admin

cp raw-fixture raw.txt
cp env-fixture vars.env
exec sesam add raw.txt vars.env
rm raw.txt vars.env

env INHERITED=kept
exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt --env-file vars.env -- env
stderr 'duplicate dotenv variable'
stderr 'TOKEN'
! stderr 'discarded-token|dotenv value'
stdout '^INHERITED=kept$'
stdout '^RAW=/dev/fd/3$'
! stdout '^SESAM_SECRET_RAW_TXT='
stdout '^TOKEN=dotenv value$'
stdout '^EMPTY=$'
stdout '^LITERAL=\$\(touch_owned\)$'
! exists raw.txt
! exists vars.env
! exists touch_owned

exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- sh -c 'cat "$RAW"'
cmp stdout raw-fixture

# Binary file contents and non-UTF-8 dotenv values survive delivery unchanged.
exec sh -c 'printf "a\000\377b\n" > "$TMPDIR/binary.expected"'
cp $TMPDIR/binary.expected binary.dat
exec sh -c 'printf "BINARY=\"a\377b\"\n" > binary.env'
exec sh -c 'printf "a\377b" > "$TMPDIR/env.expected"'
exec sesam add binary.dat binary.env
rm binary.dat binary.env
exec sesam run --secret BLOB=binary.dat -- sh -c 'cat "$BLOB"'
cmp stdout $TMPDIR/binary.expected
exec sesam run --env-file binary.env -- sh -c 'printf "%s" "$BINARY"'
cmp stdout $TMPDIR/env.expected

exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- printf '<%s>\n' 'hello world' ';touch-owned' '$HOME'
stdout '^<hello world>$'
stdout '^<;touch-owned>$'
stdout '^<\$HOME>$'
! exists touch-owned

# Dotenv-only invocations do not need file descriptors for secrets.
exec sesam run --env-file vars.env -- env
stdout '^TOKEN=dotenv value$'
! stdout '^SESAM_SECRET_VARS_ENV='

# The repository lock is released before starting the command.
exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- sesam id
stdout '^admin$'

# Cwd-relative selectors become canonical sesam-relative paths before repo use.
mkdir sub
cp raw-fixture sub/nested.txt
exec sesam add sub/nested.txt
rm sub/nested.txt
cd sub
exec sesam run --secret NESTED=./nested.txt --secret ROOT=../raw.txt -- sh -c 'cat "$NESTED"; cat "$ROOT"'
cmp stdout ../two-files.expected
! exists nested.txt

# From outside the repository selectors are sesam-relative.
cd ../..
exec sesam --sesam-dir $WORK run --secret NESTED=sub/nested.txt -- sh -c 'cat "$NESTED"'
cmp stdout $WORK/raw-fixture

-- raw-fixture --
raw-value
-- two-files.expected --
raw-value
raw-value
-- env-fixture --
# strict dotenv fixture
TOKEN=discarded-token
export TOKEN = 'dotenv value'
EMPTY=
LITERAL=$(touch_owned)
